closure: Full author mathematical body retained. Complete Theorem2.7.1 assembly and all canonical-coordinate/equivariant-Kneser/interpolation/continuity core are selected only for finite chirotopes on the fixed unit-nonloop/zero-loop weight subspace modulo SO3. Named topological representation, Kneser and Radó foundations remain original references. The broader variable-weight and global deformation claims are not selected.
current_difficulty_reason: The cited topological representation and Kneser theorems do not produce a continuous deformation on the oriented realization quotient. The author builds continuous canonical coordinates, modifies Kneser's deformation to respect precomposition by isometries, and proves that cellwise conformal interpolation depends continuously on pseudocircle boundaries. These compatibility arguments make the final quotient contraction well defined on the fixed unit-weight finite chirotope subspace.
